Egypt is a nation in the process of modernization. However, the central authority in the country is weak and we have three powerful factions in the country that will react to our actions.
 The §BMamluks§! that represent the military and nobility.
 The §BMerchants§! that represent the middle class and non aristocratic upper class.
 The §BClerics§! that represent the scholars and religious establishment.
 §RShould any of these factions become dissatisfied with our actions and disloyal, they might coup us to ensure that their vision of the future is the one we adhere to.§!

A §Gloyal§! faction supports the government. A §Wneutral§! faction is somewhere in the middle, they might be close to becoming disloyal. A §Rdisloyal§! faction dislikes our recent actions, and unless we do something to appease them they might coup us.

The factions and what actions they support are: 

 The §BMamluks§!, they represent the military and nobility. They value military strength, expanding the nation via conquest and only support some minor reforms. 
 The §BMerchants§!, they represent the middle class and the non aristocratic upper class. They value modernization, peace and major reforms to the political and adiminstrative system. 
 The §BClerics§!, who represent the scholars and the religious establishment. They value adherence to religious laws, supporting the Caliph of Mecca, and distrust any form of change.
